title: Novartis projects slowed growth, pins hopes on billions in pipeline potential
snippet: With Kisqali going off patent and decreasing prices impacting sales, Novartis has narrowed sales guidance to 5% growth. But management remains steadfast that they have a plan to get back on track.

title: Phytoconstituents in Alopecia: Molecular Evidence, Preclinical Potential, and Emerging Delivery Strategies.
snippet: Alopecia is a multifactorial dermatological disorder characterized by partial or complete hair loss, significantly affecting patients' quality of life and psychological well-being.
